entries.claim_boundary: The exact six-state radial current and the separate Iminus/Iplus formal polarizations are certified. A wave-packet null trace, global connection, scattering channel, stability result and CPT metric are not constructed.

dispersion.statement: The rate-zero formal group is assigned to Iminus and the rate-minus-2iomega group to Iplus; no global spectrum is inferred.

lee_wald.statement: The exact six-state radial pairing is anti-Hermitian, rank six for real omega, and has Hermitian inertia (3,3) at the pilot anchor.

resonance.statement: omega=0 and endpoint thresholds remain separate; no wave-packet threshold estimate is supplied.

causal_retarded.statement: No global retarded solution or scattering map is constructed.

taub_maps.statement: No compact second-order Taub map enters this preflight.
